description.value:
Duration constant

Your Marked quarry can never be hidden or undetected from you or your Feral Bond by ordinary means; it is at best concealed. Magical, technological, or supernatural concealment still functions against you normally.

cinderfall.incomplete: Even with a working Mark predicate, this needs a conditional Immunity scoped to one specific target *and* only to mundane detection-denial (not magical) — per this pass's corrected facts, Immunity is only proposable when blanket/unconditional; a target-scoped, means-scoped partial immunity has no matching predicate mechanism. The Waywarden's central subsystem, The Mark (classes.waywarden.json flags.cinderfall.terms[0]: "designate a creature as your quarry, gaining a growing bonus to track, target, and punish it specifically"), has zero Foundry-schema footprint anywhere in the corpus. classes.waywarden.json:65 itself carries "rules": []. No card anywhere grants a TokenMark effect (site/data/cards/abilities/, class-features/, feat-effects/ are all empty scaffold directories -- confirmed via ls, contents are .gitkeep only). Real pf2e's own equivalent mechanic (Ranger's Hunt Prey) is fully buildable and precedented, but that infrastructure (an action item + a TokenMark-carrying effect item) does not exist for Waywarden and is not one of the 56 files in scope for this draft. This card is blocked until a future pass authors the base Mark action/effect.
